items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: The transcript contains no first-person references from the interviewee regarding Dorns. The text provided is primarily the Interviewer speaking about Dorns ('Dorns loved music...'), and the Interviewee's response does not establish a personal connection.

ctx.x: That was in... That was in...

ctx.s: Alvin Alcorn (co-interviewee / Marrero family member, NOT interviewer)
ctx.x: That was in... music for them. They had no regular band that he could play in, but any odd job that he could get, he did. He did. Dorns loved music. Dorns loved music and sound. They were great guests. Because they stuck to their career. They didn't give it out. But that was not his line of work. His line of work, but sometimes he gets all the message. I say something, he says I'm interfering. But I'm just trying to enlighten you on his music life. As a career, he did not accept that as a career. He doesn't like…
Garden King. Why did you, well, due to Lawrence, did he... Lawrence? How did he influence you to try music? How did your... Me and I? Yeah.
